partnership_announcements.description: AviLease established a strategic partnership with Hassana Investment Company to give investors access to aviation financing assets, leveraging AviLease’s expertise, with Hassana acquiring an initial portfolio of 10 new-technology aircraft from AviLease.

press_references.value: AviLease, Riyadh Air signs first lease for Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner

partnership_announcements.description: AviLease signed Riyadh Air’s first aircraft lease for one Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner, with delivery slated for Q4 2025, marking AviLease as the inaugural lessor partner for the new Saudi carrier.

press_references.value: PIF-backed AviLease, Hassana form aircraft leasing JV

partnership_announcements.description: AviLease and Hassana Investment Company announced a joint venture to create an aircraft leasing platform, with Hassana holding the majority stake and AviLease serving as aircraft service provider.

press_references.value: AviLease places order for up to 77 Airbus A320neo Family and A350F aircraft

partnership_announcements.description: AviLease and Airbus announced a strategic partnership involving AviLease's order for up to 77 Airbus A320neo Family and A350F aircraft, reinforcing AviLease's ambition to become a top global aircraft lessor and supporting Saudi Arabia's aviation ecosystem.

press_references.value: AviLease delivers three A320neo aircraft to strategic partner SDH Wings

partnership_announcements.description: AviLease has delivered three Airbus A320neo aircraft to SDH Wings, marking a new stage in their partnership. This is part of a broader MOU to acquire more aircraft, strengthening ties with Sichuan Development International Holdings.
